name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Platform Administration & Customer Configuration
summary: Customer-facing SaaS administrator and implementation specialist with 15+ years configuring platforms to match how a customer actually runs. Builds and maintains workflows, dashboards, CRM structures, and automation in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Salesforce environments, translating customer requests into accurate configurations and documenting every change. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix (110% of implementation targets) and retained ~94% of a reseller partner network at Birdeye by catching adoption gaps early and routing feedback to Product.

experience.title: CRM & Automation Platform Admin (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Configure and maintain CRM platforms in GoHighLevel and HubSpot for B2B service clients, including user roles and permissions, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, pipelines, and data-hygiene rules.
Built and maintain 20+ automated workflows covering lead routing, appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding, and review requests.
Translate client change requests into precise technical configurations, then train client teams hands-on on the updated setup.
Document every configuration change, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping records auditable across concurrent clients.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead flow, funnel progression, and ROI, and report results with clear recommendations.
Troubleshoot broken integrations across Zapier, Make, and n8n, writing custom code steps and SQL where a point-and-click fix falls short.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder accounts, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.
Built performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI and conversion KPIs, delivering recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing-automation tools, including Birdeye's listings-syndication solution for every partner's end customers.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization data to find adoption gaps and recommend fixes that reduced churn.
Passed structured, prioritized customer feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and tightened cross-team alignment, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Built and launched e-commerce sites for established retail businesses with physical store locations.
Defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing scope and delivery timelines.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped Accelo's CRM/PSA platform for agencies and professional-services firms, guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations.

Troubleshot workflow design and resolved technical issues during setup alongside implementation teams, tracking customer issues through Zendesk tickets and escalating account risk to leadership early.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
